d: Bambr.io is a tech company, based in Kuwait, which provides educational and consultancy services in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics and Programming. Operating as LearnIT Academy Kuwait, we are the leading Google for Education Premier Partner in MENA.

This is a full-time role for a Google Certified Trainer in AI for Education, based in Kuwait. The Trainer will be responsible for designing and delivering effective training sessions focused on AI concepts and their application in educational settings. Day-to-day tasks include facilitating training workshops in different districts of Kuwait, delivering online webinars, creating instructional materials, and ensuring knowledge transfer to empower educators and learners. Additionally, the Trainer will collaborate with stakeholders to assess training needs and continuously improve the program.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related subject.
Must be based in Kuwait and willing to travel to different districts across the country.
Willing to travel to other countries in the region (preferred).
Must have C1 level (fluent) proficiency in Arabic and English.
Google Certified Educator – Level 1 and/or Level 2 (strongly preferred).
Experience or familiarity with Google Gemini and Notebook LM is an advantage.
Proven experience in training, teaching, or professional development.
Ability to deliver engaging, hands-on training sessions.
Commitment to continuous learning and professional excellence.
Must be willing to teach different age groups ranging from school-aged children to adults.
